notes: The first colon is the Hallelujah formula; the ASV renders it as ordinary Praise ye Jehovah and each morpheme is aligned on its own merits, with the margin's Hallelujah gloss read and set aside under rule 38.
The verse's three imperatives are separate morphemes and each takes only the English written beside it; the third has no ye, so it holds its own word alone.
The object marker before the full divine name is unrepresented under rule 16: the ASV writes the object bare and spends no word on the object relation.
